description:
PROBLEM
native_program_for_root (compiler.rs:88-91) drives Job::LowerNativeProgram through drive_root_to -> world.drive_for, the UNGUARDED full drive loop. Because submit_root enqueues SeedRoot (world.rs:513) which self-schedules SealSemanticClosure -> DeriveTransportPlan, the entire legacy semantic+transport ladder executes on every JIT/AOT compile, in parallel with the pull product build. compile_root_jit/run_root_jit (compiler.rs:339/353) and compile_root_aot (compiler.rs:414) all route through this.

GOAL (depends on the native lowering no longer reading world.transport_plan)
Route native/JIT/AOT through the same guarded product boundary as interp. Native must build the BackendProgram via the product driver (build_backend_product) and then lower it, without driving SeedRoot -> SealSemanticClosure -> DeriveTransportPlan. Either guard the native drive with forbidden_product_path_job, or have native demand only LowerNativeProgram whose sole prerequisite is the BackendProgram product fact.

SIGNAL
A JIT and an AOT compile of enum_reduce show zero SealSemanticClosure, DeriveTransportPlan, DeriveExecutableTransport, DeriveRuntimeDemand, and root_executable_frontier job/telemetry fires for the root. Interp, JIT, and AOT all reach LowerNativeProgram/BackendProgram through one product path (three-path parity).

NOTE
This is also the real fix behind fz-go4.14 (backend-only roots should not enqueue native lowering) on the demand-purity side.
title: Route native/JIT/AOT front doors through the guarded product driver
